result.markdown:
# Incident Report: S-TUN-015 Power Failure

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** power_failure at `S-TUN-015`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct alarms (MAINS_FAILURE, BATTERY_LOW, SITE_DOWN) observed on S-TUN-015 match the exact anomaly window. Maintenance and configuration changes were checked and ruled out. External events were NOT CHECKED.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-08 17:30 to 2026-09-08 22:00
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-08 14:16
- **Affected:** S-TUN-015

## Summary

Site S-TUN-015 suffered a power failure starting with mains loss at 14:16, leading to a battery low alarm and a complete site shutdown from 17:36 to 21:58.

Site S-TUN-015 experienced a complete loss of availability, active users, and data volume for 4.5 hours from 17:30 to 22:00 on 2026-09-08 before full recovery.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-08 14:16: Mains failure alarm raised on S-TUN-015 [ALM-000142]
- 2026-09-08 17:21: Battery low alarm raised on S-TUN-015 [ALM-000147]
- 2026-09-08 17:30: Traffic, active users, and availability drop started on S-TUN-015 [ALR-0015, ANM-000123, ANM-000124, ANM-000125]
- 2026-09-08 17:36: Critical site down alarm raised on S-TUN-015 [ALM-000148]
- 2026-09-08 21:58: Mains failure, battery low, and site down alarms cleared on S-TUN-015 [ALM-000142, ALM-000147, ALM-000148]
- 2026-09-08 22:00: Traffic and availability anomaly ended on S-TUN-015 [ALR-0015]

## Evidence

- Site S-TUN-015 lost mains power at 14:16, transitioned to battery low at 17:21, and experienced a full site shutdown at 17:36. [ALM-000142, ALM-000147, ALM-000148, T3]
- Traffic, active users, and availability dropped on S-TUN-015 from 17:30 to 22:00. [ALR-0015, ANM-000123, ANM-000124, ANM-000125, T1]
- Mains power and full site operations were restored at 21:58 when related power alarms cleared. [ALM-000142, ALM-000147, ALM-000148, T3]
- No maintenance windows or local configuration changes occurred on S-TUN-015 during the incident. [T4, T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **power_failure** at S-TUN-015: confirmed. Direct observation of MAINS_FAILURE, BATTERY_LOW, and SITE_DOWN alarms matching the exact timeframe of the traffic drop. [ALM-000142, ALM-000147, ALM-000148, ALR-0015]
2. **bad_change** at S-TUN-015: rejected. No changes were performed on S-TUN-015 or its immediate parents during the incident window. [T4]
3. **planned_maintenance** at S-TUN-015: rejected. No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-TUN-015 or its parent path during the incident. [T5]

## Ruled out

- CHG-2026-0023: Software upgrade on CORE-UPF-01 occurred on 2026-09-09 at 04:31, well after the S-TUN-015 incident had already resolved.
- ALM-000159: Link loss on LNK-TUN-02-C occurred on 2026-09-09 at 02:26 on a different node branch below AGG-TUN-02.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect site S-TUN-015 power supply units and mains feed stability to prevent recurring power outages.
